text:
Zoe Kim: Quick sync about the micro-summit next week: goals = capture 300 leads, promote the 7pm webinar, and collect 20 demo signups. Need final checklist: swag packing, speaker slide cutoffs, QR webhooks, and live social plan.

Arjun Patel: Swag counts: mugs 120, stickers 600, hoodies 40. Recommend holding 10 mugs for VIPs. Packing list in Drive: /marketing/events/micro-summit/packlist.csv

Logan (ops): Venue notes: load-in 08:15, power at table A3, venue WiFi unreliable  bring portable hotspot. Courier pickup scheduled Thu 18:00.

Nina - Content: Draft micro-post: "We shaved ~16% average token-latency on typical product prompts. Swing by Booth A or scan to join the 7pm webinar: redwood.ai/micro-webinar?utm=booth". Keep claims soft and include link to bench page.

Maya Patel: Good. Nina please change copy to: "~16% average token-latency improvement on dev workloads" and add the webinar CTA. Also prepare 2 visuals: one for the booth placard (8x4) and one for Twitter.

Arjun Patel: QR flow: collect email, company, role, interest (webinar/demo/bench). Webhook payload sample: {"email":"qa+1@acme.com","interest":"webinar","utm":"booth"}. I'll run a smoke test Wed 09:30.

Logan (ops): I'll bring label printer + two power strips + folding chair. Note: monitor stand is one-only, so coordinate demos.

Nina - Content: Social plan: 3 tweets pre-event (announce booth + stat), a live RT of speaker clip, and post-event recap linking webinar recording. Drafts in /marketing/content/drafts.

CDNBot: Static asset upload succeeded: /assets/micro-bench-v2.png (sha: d4c3b2).

Maya Patel: Staffing: Zoe + Arjun morning, Maya + Nina afternoon. Eli from Sales to float 11:30-13:00. Zoe please own 24hr lead triage.

Arjun Patel: One more ask: add a hidden priority field computed by domain + role so SDRs can pick enterprise leads first.

Logan (ops): Courier delayed to Thu 18:20. Updated tracking in packlist.

Zoe Kim: Smoke test scheduled Wed 09:30. I'll post results here. If all green, we'll push micro-post Fri 09:00 and enable QR live at 08:45.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Final action list: Nina finalize copy + visuals, Arjun run webhook smoke, Logan confirm kit + hotspot, Zoe run triage + publish.

Arjun Patel: Roger.

Nina - Content: Roger.

Logan (ops): Roger.
